verdict.rationale: Galileo's own official MCP server lets AI IDEs such as Cursor and VS Code with Copilot drive it, so users can create datasets, run experiments and set up prompt templates through natural-language prompts. The release notes also mention an in-product AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems, and the docs describe natural-language feedback for tuning metrics. However, natural-language operation inside the product is documented only by a single release-note line, and the MCP path depends on an external AI client. Missing for 10: a documented in-product natural-language command interface covering broad operations, detail on the AI Assistant's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
